items.title: IRDAI proposes tighter controls on insurance distribution costs
items.grounded_note: India's regulator proposed limits and restructuring for distributor commissions, restrictions on compulsory insurance bundling with loans, stronger suitability and disclosure requirements, and an expanded role for digital infrastructure including Bima Sugam. The consultation could materially alter bancassurance and agency economics in a major AIA market.

source_links.title: IRDAI proposes tighter controls on insurance distribution costs

items.title: IASB completes technical discussions on revised equity-method accounting standard
items.grounded_note: The IASB completed technical discussions on revising IAS 28 for investments in associates and joint ventures. The revised standard is expected in the first half of 2027 and would apply from 1 January 2029, with early application permitted. It may affect accounting and investor comparability for insurers, including AIA, that report material associate or joint-venture investments under IFRS.
